title: Puzzle3d Attraction Session Reference Error
description: Fix ReferenceError: attractionSession is not defined in Inner useMemo deps at index.tsx:7058
summary:
Fixed runtime crash in `Inner` (`CanvasImpl`): `useMemo` dependency array referenced bare `attractionSession` which was never defined in scope; JSX already used `props.attractionSession`. Replaced dep with `props.attractionSession`.

Tests: `bun ./script.ts test` in `puzzle/3d/react` — 146/146 passed.
